title: Change of base of a fibre product along a separated morphism is a closed immersion
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ and $g:Y\to T$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with the same target, and let $h:T\to S$ be a separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Then the induced morphism $X\times_TY\to X\times_SY$ of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] (the fibre product over $S$ formed with $h\circ f$ and $h\circ g$; the morphism has components the two projections) is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
